decisions.reason: As a resin injection unit closely related to the firm's plural-component and construction-focused applications, it is worth keeping as a niche option unless several years of sales have clearly underperformed.
Management would likely keep it, but because it overlaps with another resin injection unit the chance of later portfolio rationalization is somewhat higher if demand has not differentiated the model.

An automatic airless spray gun fits the firm's core coating technology and installed customer base, so the option value of staying in this segment is high and the cost of keeping it available is likely moderate.
A manual airless spray gun is very close to the firm's established offering and service capabilities, making it a relatively low-risk product to continue carrying.
This broader product line with several models is strongly aligned with the firm's core spray application business, so keeping it preserves valuable market coverage at low incremental uncertainty.
The data logger appears to have lost prominence on the website after launch, and as a more peripheral digital add-on with ongoing support demands it is the weakest option to keep open.
